nws_alerts.headline: High Surf Advisory issued November 25 at 2:08PM PST until November 27 at 4:00AM PST by NWS San Diego CA
nws_alerts.description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Warning, significant coastal
flooding expected. For the High Surf Advisory, large breaking
waves of 6-8 feet, sets up to 10-12 feet along west-facing
beaches.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Warning, through 1 PM PST Friday.
For the High Surf Advisory, through 4 AM PST Friday. Most
susceptible time of flooding will be around the time of the
morning high tide, around 9 AM on Thursday and 10 PM on Friday.

* IMPACTS...Numerous roads may be closed. Low lying property
including homes, businesses, and some critical infrastructure
will be inundated. Some shoreline erosion will occur.
Dangerous swimming and surfing conditions and localized beach
erosion.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...King tides on Thursday will be around 8
feet. Background surf on top of the tides will remain around 3-6
feet today. A long period west swell arrives late this
afternoon and will bring elevated to high surf by Thursday
morning's high tide. Breaking waves may reach 6-8 feet with
local sets up to 10-12 feet on west-facing beaches. Surf lowers
to 3-6 feet by Friday morning's high tide.
